name: Property of the Mafia
source:
This pain persists you can't resist. Fate has been nothing but cruel to you. You don't know who you are anymore. Despair has completely consumed you.

Can you find a way out? Or will you be consumed and reborn as The Ultimate Daughter of Despair?
